scope: NEP4-C, 5760 atoms (20x6x6 conventional cells), 300 K, 0 GPa, isotropic orthorhombic PBC; single node
parallel_comparison: base: same-P off for local modes and P1 off for replicated modes; half: P1 off anchor for the two registered local conditions; no long-trajectory bitwise requirement

precision_gates.estimator: existing Geyer estimator and tests/npt/paired_confirmation_math.py; reject incomplete blocks

absolute_mean_gates.scr: each registered condition: temperature CI within 300 +/- 6 K and pressure CI within 0 +/- 0.1 GPa
absolute_mean_gates.nvt: each registered volume: temperature CI within 300 +/- 6 K
absolute_mean_gates.precision: same mean ESS, squared-deviation ESS and complete-block gates as other metrics; any zero-variance chain or constant squared-deviation chain makes its precision INCONCLUSIVE

equivalence_bounds.confidence: Approximate Bonferroni simultaneous 95% across registered intervals, relying on approximately independent complete blocks, truncated Geyer autocorrelation estimates and percentile bootstrap; not unconditional finite-sample coverage. Mean differences use same-seed paired seed means and conservative independent-block standard errors; variance ratios resample shared seed clusters and independently resample each side's time blocks, 200000 replicates with analysis seed 2026110601

independent_scientific_reference.method: finite-temperature NVT pressure-volume response, independent runs at 300 K at three registered relative volumes 0.99, 1.00, 1.01; fit pressure vs volume to estimate zero-pressure volume and isothermal compressibility; compare fluctuation variance k_B T kappa_T <V> to NPT variance
independent_scientific_reference.criterion: simultaneous 95% CI for SCR mean volume minus fitted zero-pressure volume lies wholly within ±0.25% of fitted volume, and independent-response predicted variance ratio CI lies wholly in [0.85,1.15]; if fitted slope is not significantly negative, zero-pressure volume is outside fitted bracket, or precision is insufficient, INCONCLUSIVE
independent_scientific_reference.thermostat: nvt_bdp 300 K, Tdamp 40 steps; rank 1 HostStaged; ensemble RNG seed equal to model seed
independent_scientific_reference.volume_definition: relative volume multipliers 0.99, 1.00, 1.01 applied isotropically as cube-root to registered 20x6x6 model positions and box
independent_scientific_reference.curvature_gate: Bonferroni one-sided upper confidence bound on absolute difference between zero-pressure roots from the left and right NVT secants, divided by OLS zero-pressure volume, must be <=0.0025; either nonnegative secant slope makes the bootstrap draw invalid

stop_rule: one final analysis after every complete chain and deterministic/route/RNG gates pass; no interim statistical looks, extensions, substituted seeds, restarts, or threshold changes; with sufficient precision, a confidence interval wholly outside its allowed range is FAIL, a crossing interval is INCONCLUSIVE, and an interval wholly inside passes; insufficient precision is INCONCLUSIVE; empirical ECDF above its bound is FAIL; the registered one-sided curvature upper bound above its limit is INCONCLUSIVE; aggregate any FAIL as FAIL, otherwise any INCONCLUSIVE as INCONCLUSIVE; any rerun requires new registration
execution_status: APPROVED_FOR_ONE_PRE_REGISTERED_BATCH; EXECUTION_FREEZE_REQUIRED; results and progress are maintained externally in the registration-SHA ledger

analysis_details.alpha: Bonferroni 0.05 over 56 parallel, 12 timestep, 32 response, 16 curvature, 32 SCR absolute means and 3 NVT temperature intervals = 151 intervals
analysis_details.nvt_bootstrap: resample seed clusters and aligned time blocks jointly across three NVT volumes; independent resampling of SCR chains
analysis_details.cdf: direct pooled empirical ECDF distance, deterministic observed-sample criterion; no population coverage claim
analysis_details.scope: all base conditions and only P1/HostStaged, P2/HostStaged/affine, P4/CudaAware/affine for half timestep

timestep_comparison.conditions: same three conditions in half profile, same seed: post-burn half rows at indices 1,3,... vs base rows, preserving equal physical time grid and 500-step blocks
timestep_comparison.bounds: same registered temperature/pressure/volume mean, volume variance ratio, and empirical volume ECDF bounds

approval_evidence.historical_cpu_receipt_scope: The receipt is historical, not an identity claim for all current files. Changed files are listed explicitly; subsequent geometry evidence and GPU supplements remain separately bound.
approval_evidence.candidate_receipt_scope: Production candidate and its source snapshot are bound by the build receipt; its historical tests/CMakeLists.txt differs from current and is not represented as current.
approval_evidence.historical_failures: Original high-symmetry pressure reference FAIL and initial thermostat audit FAIL are retained; independent jitter pressure audit and separately recorded restart-count correction/v2 audit are the later supporting evidence.
approval_evidence.audit_limits: Final nightly audit does not independently bind execution log integrity or replay all trajectory-derived values; NVT audit does not hash original short/protocol logs or replay full numerical trajectories. These limits remain in the cited audit reports.
approval_evidence.execution: One complete 152-chain batch, no interim statistical looks, extension, seed substitution, chain restart or retry; one final analysis. Freeze binds inputs, software, candidate, libraries, environment and unique ledger before execution.
approval_evidence.approval_scope: The root reviewer approved the complete fixed 152-chain protocol after verifying all 46 bound evidence and software identities and the unchanged scientific fields. Execution is authorized only after the required immutable execution freeze; approved files remain unchanged during execution and progress/results are recorded externally in the registration-SHA ledger.
